Facilitators Wanted for the Professional Growth Weekend
By Lena Hofstra
Each fall, members from across the region gather for our Professional Growth Weekend, and this year we are again looking for experienced members to serve as volunteer small-group facilitators.
Over the two days, each facilitator guides a group of eight to ten members through practical discussions on topics such as office budgets. Facilitators keep the conversation moving and make sure everyone has a chance to speak.

A Bigger Home for Riverbend's Music
The chamber series returns to an expanded Pelham Hall next month.
After a year of building work, Pelham Hall now has a balcony that adds 120 seats to its original 280. The stage has also been widened, allowing larger groups of musicians to perform together.
Pianist Lukas Varga will give the first concert of the season on Saturday, September 20, and a visiting string quartet will arrive in November.
